motivation: remove the redundant Fusion visual encoder while preserving native skeleton frames before cross-modal attention

evidence_before_freeze.diagnostic_note: post-hoc leave-one-branch-out evidence; not a promotable candidate

input_contract.visual: one strict fold R(2+1)D-34 stem through layer2; one 16-frame crop; spatially pooled tokens; no second visual encoder or multi-window pass
input_contract.skeleton: all ordered native H36M-17 frames, center-truncated only above 256, zero-padded with an explicit per-frame validity mask; no interpolation or 16-frame resampling
input_contract.baseline: the matching strict fold DSTFormer plus residual-TCN logits

model_contract.skeleton_queries: coordinates plus valid adjacent-frame velocity projected to 128 dimensions
model_contract.temporal_processing: stride-1 local residual convolution; no skeleton temporal downsampling before pooling
model_contract.fusion: four-head cross-attention with skeleton frames as queries and visual layer2 tokens as keys/values
model_contract.output: zero-initialized residual correction added to the frozen temporal logits

training_contract.selection: fixed final epoch; held labels evaluated once
